question: Across the exact same 169 complete no-movement pure-far recordings, does magnitude-squared mic/render coherence measured with a segment geometry derived only from the unchanged baseline 96 ms AEC span remain high when single-delay correlation is weak, and how does that coherence co-vary descriptively with public DTD occupancy without deriving any detector boundary, filter, gain correction, or source candidate?

source.rating_formula: last half of each common-length mic+lpb clip

selection.rule: all GUIDs at the exact source revision that have both GUID_farend_singletalk_lpb.wav and GUID_farend_singletalk_mic.wav; exclude every with_movement file; no result-dependent filtering

baseline_geometry_source.research_probe_config_source: .github/research/continuous-optimization/pure_far_activity_ratio_probe.c initializes ap_config_default(AP_PROFILE_CALL), forces 16 kHz mono and disables only beamforming
baseline_geometry_source.pipeline_rule: ap_pipeline_init computes taps = aec_filter_ms * internal_sample_rate_hz / 1000 before AP_AEC_CAP clamp

analysis_geometry.frequency_bins: all bins with nonzero accumulated mic and render power
analysis_geometry.rating_interval: official last-half interval after raw best-delay alignment
analysis_geometry.split_stability: repeat identical coherence geometry on the two equal halves of the aligned official rating interval
analysis_geometry.segment_boundary_limitation: non-overlapping rectangular segments do not model convolution across segment boundaries; this is an observation limitation, not a tunable parameter

observation_method.public_dtd_evidence: regenerate frozen pure-far Activity-ratio coverage on the exact 169-pair inventory using the unchanged read-only Activity probe
observation_method.delay_alignment: recompute frozen route-probe raw best_delay_samples for each exact case; ignore all historical route decision booleans
observation_method.coherence_metric: magnitude-squared coherence |sum X*conj(Y)|^2 / (sum |X|^2 * sum |Y|^2), accumulated across fixed non-overlapping segments independently per FFT bin
reported_aggregations: first-half versus second-half absolute coherence deltas
case-level descriptive Spearman associations with public DTD and frozen smoothed mic/reference ratio

provenance_limitations.statement: High or low coherence can describe linear coupling in the pinned recordings but cannot uniquely identify room multipath, hardware gain, capture DSP, nonlinear processing, noise, or another physical cause because upstream per-GUID device-chain metadata are absent.

prohibited_actions: derive or search a coherence threshold
fit, estimate, apply, or ship an FIR echo-path filter from this diagnostic
apply gain normalization or signal correction
turn coherence or any association into a classifier, ranking, pass/fail boundary, tuning rule, or source-candidate selector
optimize FFT length, window, overlap, tail span, frequency range, delay geometry, or sample selection against observed results
infer device identity, hardware gain, AGC state, microphone sensitivity, loudspeaker gain, room impulse response, or capture-DSP state not present upstream
change DSP source, public DTD semantics, Activity/VAD thresholds, timers, or parameter values
revive I009 echo-normalized or residual-echo rescue
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may describe whether weak single-delay correlation in the pinned pure-far corpus coexists with stronger frequency-domain linear coherence at a geometry derived only from the unchanged baseline 96 ms AEC span, and how those observables co-vary with public DTD occupancy. It cannot establish a physical cause, a detector boundary, an echo-path filter, a normalization rule, or candidate authority.
